spans.s:
√hlād 'refresh'
present: [1.] hlādate etc. 
[perfect: jahlāde ajihladat ahlādiṣṭa hlādiṣyate hlāditā hlanna ]
secondary: causative: hlādayati hlādayate etc. ahlādayiṣata 
derivatives: hradá V.+ hlāda U.+ hlādaka V.B. hlādin E.+ hlādana E.+ hlāduka TA. hlāduni C. hrādúni V.B.U. -hlādayitṛ C. 
Only one or two late sporadic forms outside the causative conjugation; and the proper form of the root seems to be hlad (or hrad).
